title: Structured browser MCP exposure qualification
objective: Qualify each closed structured browser shape (SG-000021 through SG-000026) against a live browser engine before any MCP exposure, expose only shapes that are qualified against real browser behavior, and record an explicit, test-pinned decision for every shape that is not, with no arbitrary JavaScript executor, generic DevTools, debugger, or hidden network primitive.

include: a per-shape qualification of the structured browser layer against live browser behavior, identifying whether each shape drives a real engine or only the policy and page-registry model
MCP exposure only for shapes qualified against a live engine
an explicit decision record and contract tests that keep every unqualified shape off the MCP surface and prove the browser layer opens no browser, debugger, or network channel
updates to the parity inventory and canonical documentation reflecting the decision
exclude: exposing model-only shapes as if they controlled a real browser
arbitrary JavaScript execution, generic DevTools or CDP access, debugger attachment, personal-profile access, or any hidden network primitive
desktop, clipboard, or network exposure (SG-000063 and SG-000064)

authority_delta.browser: Only live-qualified structured shapes may be exposed; none is exposed if none qualifies.

invariants: no MCP tool claims browser capability that the implementation does not have
no arbitrary script, DevTools, debugger, or personal-profile authority
unqualified browser shapes stay hidden and test-pinned

acceptance.claim: Every structured browser shape is qualified as live-engine or model-only with evidence from the implementation.
Only live-qualified shapes are exposed; every unqualified shape is recorded with its reason and pinned off the MCP surface by contract tests.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000063: Structured desktop MCP exposure may proceed only after SG-000062 closes.

done_when: Structured browser exposure is decided per shape on live-engine evidence, with no model-only capability presented as real.
